text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at six thirty and drink a glass of water before breakfast. After that, I get ready for work and leave home at eight. I work from nine to five, with a short lunch break at noon. In the afternoon, I often go to the gym or take a walk in the park. In the evening, I have dinner with my family, watch some TV, or read a book. I try to go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent helps me feel healthy, energetic, and ready for each new day.
